show.name: Горнолыжка
show.summary: Reliable and fair, Misha has worked as a crane operator at the port in the small provincial town of Zavodskoy all his life. When the port owner once again fails to pay his workers, Misha stands up for his colleagues – and naturally ends up without a job. Misha is burdened by his lazy son, Timur – a carefree adventurer who never misses an opportunity to make easy money, but every time he fails and accumulates debts. Trying to stay afloat, Misha miraculously gets a job at an elite ski resort. Everything here is arranged in a strict order: team discipline, a schedule, different personalities, and a multitude of tasks that need to be handled on the fly – from everyday little things to conflicts with inspectors and sometimes with guests. The resort is run by a demanding yet caring Katya, for whom Misha gradually develops feelings. The only problem is that Katya is in a serious relationship – and not just with anyone, but with Denis, the owner of the very port where Misha used to work. This is how a love triangle is formed, turning every day at the resort into a series of force majeure situations, where not only the characters' personal happiness is at risk, but also the smooth operation of the entire ski resort.

body.name: Серия 9

show.name: Седьмой игрок
show.summary:
"Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director.

The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.

show.summary: The end of the Great Patriotic War, the beginning of the Cold war with the West, the nuclear race and the struggle for power in closed cabinets — how were the decisions that determined the course of world history actually made? The secret details of the last years of the life of one of the most controversial politicians of the 20th century.

show.summary:
After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator.

To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities.
Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

show.name: Her Willing Subject
show.summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

show.name: Silent Echoes
show.summary: In 2011, a murder case occurs at Jiugu Lake in Xiping City. Detective Ma Xuesong and rookie female officer Meng Wen begin investigating and discover the case is linked to the disappearance of Luo Xue, involving multiple parties including the Deli Group. As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

show.name: Blossom in Darkness
show.summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.name: The Story Untold
show.summary: Adapted from Twentine's novel The Story Untold, the drama follows Yang Zhao, an art restorer haunted by childhood trauma. She has long believed that her emotional wounds will never heal, until she meets Chen Mingsheng, a narcotics officer working undercover in Bai Ji's drug trafficking organization. Their encounter profoundly affects them both, but when his mission goes wrong, Chen Mingsheng is forced to disappear from Yang Zhao's life. Their abruptly interrupted relationship leaves an indelible mark on her heart. Three years later, Yang Zhao unexpectedly reunites with Chen Mingsheng in another city. Having lost a leg, he now lives an unassuming life as a taxi driver. Determined never to let him go again, Yang Zhao finally opens up to him, revealing her true self and allowing him into her world. However, during a trip, Chen Mingsheng's identity is exposed, forcing him to return to the front lines of the fight against drug trafficking. The two promise never to be separated again once his mission is complete. Yet when Yang Zhao finally receives news of Chen Mingsheng, she rushes to the hospital, only to find him fighting for his life. As she watches helplessly, she has no idea what fate has in store for them...

show.name: The Glory Fades
show.summary: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

show.name: Taming the Husband
show.summary: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

show.name: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
show.summary: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

body.summary: Nicola takes matters into her own hands. Gina faces a difficult decision. Denise's resilience is put to the test.

show.name: EastEnders
show.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Zhu Xian
show.summary: A terrible calamity has fallen onto Zhang Fan, not only becoming one of the three survivors of Grass Temple Village, where everyone else was horribly massacred, he was also tasked to carry one of the most evil artifacts, the Sinister Bead, and taught one of the most secret teachings of the Skysong Sect, the Brahmin Wisdom. Now he cultivates in the Jadeon Sect, his knowledge and possession will draw him into a chaotic story where he will have to carry some of the greatest burdens of the Martial World.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

show.summary:
In order to be pampered by girls, Ren has been "Selling BL" (fanservice) by flirting with Issei, a handsome guy who attends the same college. But one day, Ren is suddenly kissed by Issei?!

A fascinating love comedy that begins with a lie.

show.name: Days of Our Lives
show.summary:
Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

body.name: The Next Drama
body.summary: Coachella weekend is upon the Kardashian clan. Kourtney makes it a family affair in the desert and really lets loose with Kylie and Kendall. Kris faces her feelings on Kim's book, meanwhile, after a busy week of business, Khloé has some fun.

show.name: The Kardashians
show.summary: Just when you think life can't get any faster in the Kardashian-Jenner family, they punch it into overdrive. From the big screen to baby bliss, the family continues to defy expectations in all their endeavors. Cameras roll as Kourtney, Kim, Khloé, Kendall, and Kylie navigate contentious sister dynamics, all under the watchful eye of everyone's favorite matriarch, Kris.

show.summary: Actor Dragomir Mrsic leads the program where board games meet reality. Get ready for a nerve-wracking murder mystery game where we, the viewers, become witnesses behind the scenes. 18 participants, completely unaware of each other, arrive at Häringe Castle and are put to tough tests in the psychological game. Who in the group can be trusted, which blacksmiths cheat and above all who are the Traitors?

show.name: Als de brandweer
show.summary: Traffic accidents and resuscitation, but also elevator confinements, escaped animals and entrapments: the fire brigade does so much more than just extinguish fires. Als de brandweer shows the work of the Dutch fire department and shows what it is like to be in the shoes of these heroes when they head for an incident from a barracks. What starts in the emergency room with a frightened emergency call is given a follow-up if they get into the tanker syringe within one minute and blow out with screaming sirens. Never before have viewers come so close to the fire. They experience everything through the eyes of the firefighters, who portray their work themselves with different cameras.

body.name: Marta Elena Vento
body.summary: Investigating the murder of Marta Elena Vento, who was killed while working alone as a receptionist at a Travelodge in Bournemouth in 2020. Her killer, Stephen Cole, was a 32-year-old man with a diagnosed mental illness who had been released from prison six weeks earlier.

show.name: Britain's Hotel Murders
show.summary:
Britain's Hotel Murders uses contemporary footage, newly-shot interviews with eyewitnesses and experts who can piece together the disturbingly dark narratives of the troubling killers who used hotels as their hunting grounds and unsuspecting hideouts.

With compelling first-hand testimonies the series unveils the hidden dangers which the anonymity of overnight stays can present, and the horror stories that have affected the victims to this day.

show.name: Canada's Drag Race
show.summary: Competing for the title of Canada's Next Drag Superstar, and a $100,000 grand prize, Canada's Drag Race tracks Canadian drag artists as they vie for the title of "Canada's Next Drag Superstar." Each episode tests their limits by having them compete in singing, dancing, acting, impersonation, design, and improvisation challenges. Competitors are eliminated until one queen is left standing with the crown, scepter, and coveted title. Throughout their journey to the crown, the queens showcase the importance of celebrating everyone's Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve, and Talent.
